events.title: Commercial checkride
events.description: Commercial pilot practical test at KCDW. Oral portion completed September 24, 2026; flight portion rebooked for October 1, 2026 at 14:00 EDT (confirmed), expected around 14:00–16:00 EDT (2 hours). The 12:00–19:00 window is forecast context, not flight duration or scheduling flexibility. Prioritize maneuvering room and landing-window gusts throughout the expected flight.
